in 2015. Her interior design and exterior styling comes from the drawing boards of Mondo Marine, while Mondo Marine is responsible for her naval architecture.
ACCOMMODATIONS
Serenity is equipped to welcome up to twelve guests in five beautifully appointed cabins, each characterized by a distinct elegance and a dedication to providing a serene private retreat for every occupant.
The centerpiece of Serenity's guest accommodation is the master suite, a split-level sanctuary that epitomizes the yacht's commitment to luxury and privacy. Occupying a prime position on the upper deck, the owner's cabin offers panoramic views through expansive windows, ensuring an immersive connection with the sea. The cabin is appointed with high-gloss rosewood veneer and custom furniture, set against the pristine backdrop of white Calacatta marble framed in Portoro, crafting an environment of both warmth and sophistication. The suite includes a vast bathroom with a striking freestanding bath, accented by exquisite mosaics and marble, alongside a spacious dressing area that caters to all needs with elegance and style.
Further enhancing the owner's experience, the suite boasts direct access to a private forward deck area, complete with a raised sunpad-covered plinth for relaxation and enjoyment of the surrounding vistas. The addition of fold-down balconies on either side of the cabin amplifies the available space, seamlessly blending the indoors with the natural beauty outside.
The yacht's lower deck is home to the remaining guest accommodations, which consist of four guest suites, each offering a unique color scheme and a soothing atmosphere. Al Maidan’s design expertise is evident in the thoughtful selection of colors, fabrics, and decorative elements that create an understated yet luxurious ambiance. Serenity also includes accommodation for a crew of up to 7, ensuring that every aspect of the guest experience is catered to with the utmost professionalism and discretion. The crew quarters are situated forward on the lower deck, completely separate from the guest areas to maintain privacy. description:
Don’t just own a superyacht, own a fleet of superyachts
in the most desirable destinations around the world—all at a fraction of the cost of owning a single superyacht, thanks to the SeaNet Yacht Club co-ownership program.
With 23 years of experience and over 75 co-ownership yachts sold, SeaNet Yachts is the co-ownership market leader. And now SeaNet introduces the world’s first co-ownership fleet program: the SeaNet Yacht Club.
Explore the world’s best destinations year over year for $4M with a 20% share in this fully equipped $20M Benetti Oasis 34M, including 38ft tender and all the water toys you might desire (see full details below).
This extravagantly appointed Oasis 34M is destined for the Caribbean, the Bahamas and South Florida, while another equally well-spec’ed Benetti Oasis 34M in the fleet is already operating in the Mediterranean (see the “Mediterranean fleet member” in the photos), with more yachts joining the fleet in other top cruising destinations around the world. With every additional yacht entering the fleet, your options to cruise the world expand.
By co-owning a fleet of superyachts around the world, you can hop between continents within days while skipping the expense in time and money to relocate your yacht—something that single yacht owners can only dream of.
And while the fleet is shared with other co-owners, the experience is fully personalized to you, so that when you are onboard it is all yours. This is your yacht after all.
If you won’t use your yacht the whole year, then why own the whole yacht?
Right-size your ownership to the amount of time you want to enjoy. A 20% share gets you up to 40 days a year onboard your very own superyacht. And with the SeaNet SuperFleet you can enjoy that time aboard any of the yachts in your fleet around the world.
The fleet is professionally managed, so all you’re left with is the joy of ownership. Own 100% of the experience with 0% of the headache, for 20% of the investment. Own a share in the SeaNet Yacht Club.
SeaNet Yacht Club
SeaNet is launching the SeaNet Yacht Club for several different tiers of yachts, including the Benetti Oasis 34M. It consists of:
3 identical extravagantly equipped 34M/112ft Benetti Oasis superyachts in the top 3 yachting destinations: Caribbean, Mediterranean, and soon Southeast Asia.
Own a share in one, enjoy your time on all yachts in the fleet.
A 20% share comes with up to 40 days onboard per year—four 10-day trips. Want more time? Get more shares.
Optional 24-day SuperTrip during your priority year.
All yachts are professionally managed by the market leading team at SeaNet.
Another Yacht Club SeaNet is launching is for the Absolute Navetta 75, available for $1.7M per 25% share.
Curious to learn more? Use the contact form to connect and we’ll get your questions answered.
The Benetti Oasis 34M
The Benetti Oasis is arguably the most popular design from Benetti to date, and for good reason. Benetti took what is called the “beach club”—the lounging area at the stern dedicated to enjoying the ocean—and reinvented it to something entirely its own: the Oasis. With its fold-out bulwarks, it packs an incredible amount of space that seamlessly flows from the water line, with multiple levels, an infinity plunge pool and plenty of freestanding and built-in seating, up to the aft lounge.
Of course, this is not the only jaw dropping design feature of the Oasis 34M, it is packed with beauty and ingenuity.
With five spacious staterooms for a total of 10 guests, plus up to seven crew, it is like your personal seven star resort. Multiple entertainment spaces, from the Oasis to the bow across the main, upper and sun decks, provide all the space you’ll desire for large group dinners and intimate conversations, from breakfast buffets to sundowner cocktails.
The Benetti Oasis 43M is our superyacht of choice to launch the first SeaNet Yacht Club as it provides an incredible platform for exploring the best destinations across the seven seas.
Equipment & Toys
Possibly the best equipped Oasis 34M, she comes equipped with every possible water toy worth owning, so that every moment aboard creates memories worth savoring for years to come.
Skipper 38NC Superyacht Tender
First of all, she has the best superyacht tender one could want: a Skipper 38NC. Made near Athens, Greece, this award winning tender is crafted to perfection. Powered by dual 500HP engines she can travel at speeds exceeding 80 MPH with ample space for all guests aboard the Benetti. This is your perfect excursion platform. Comfortable, fast, with plenty of seating, a day-head, and with all the power to pull any tow-behind water toy you might like.
Sea-Doo Spark Trixx Jetskis
Not one, but two of the easiest and most fun jetskis are onboard. The Sea-Doo Spark Trixx is—as the name suggests—built for tricks. So not only are they fast (50 MPH fast, thanks to the 90HP engine) but also incredibly fun to do  tricks with, like 180s, wheelies, donuts and more.
Seabob F9 water scooters
Not one, not two, but four Seabob F9 water scooters, taking you over—and under—water with incredible speed and agility. Great for fun on the water, and for exploring under water. Go explore together!
Suparyacht slide & climbing wall
Imagine stepping onto an inflatable water slide four decks above the water, and sliding down your very own super slide! How do you get back to the sun deck to go again? By climbing the four decks tall inflatable climbing wall, of course!
Inflatables & tow-behinds
The Skipper tender is an excellent platform to get around on in style, with comfort and speed. It’s also an excellent tender for towing you on a wake-board, inflatable donut and other fun watertoys. You’ll find them all aboard your yacht.
E-foils
Ever wanted to try one of those surfboards that glide effortlessly
above
the water? You’ll find two e-foils onboard, and we’ll teach you how to use them!
Everything else
And there’s more. Of course, you’ll have all your standard fare, such as standup paddle boards, snorkel gear, and more.
Floating docks & AquaBana
With so many toys at your disposal, we needed a bit more space than the aft deck provided to set them all out, so we extended the already vast Oasis with more floating docks and a floating cabana, the AquaBana. If you call it your personal water park, we won’t mind.
Have a favorite water toy you want onboard? Use the contact form to connect and let’s discuss if we can add it on.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I schedule time onboard?
Each 20% share comes with up to 4 trips per year. Each trip takes 10 days, from Friday through next week’s Sunday. Each yacht has an annual itinerary and schedule from which you can pick your trips. So that all owners get a fair share of picking their favorite dates, a rotating priority provides first choice to a different owner each year. In order of priority, each owner picks their first trip, then each owner picks their second trip, and so forth.
How do I schedule time on other yachts within my Yacht Club?
While you own a share of a specific yacht in a specific location, since the yacht is part of the Yacht Club, you can enjoy your time aboard on any of the other identical yachts in your fleet around the world. Your priority schedule not only cycles through the owners of your yacht, it also cycles through the other yachts in your fleet, so you get your priority picks around the globe.
All scheduling is easily done using the SeaNet co-owners app, or with a quick call with your SeaNet concierge.
Will my yacht feel generic?
To the contrary. Even though each yacht is co-owned by up to 5 owners, each owner typically customizes the yacht to their taste with their own linens, art and other personal items. The SeaNet SuperFleet crew will personalize your yacht for your stay, and switch it out for the next owner. Because, the goal is that while you’re onboard, it is 100% your yacht.
Can I sell my share?
Yes. You may sell your share at any time, and SeaNet is happy to help find a new buyer. Reselling of shares is common and the resale value depreciates at roughly the same rate as the yacht itself—and often a little less because the value is more in the experience and less in the age of the yacht.
Have more questions? Use the contact form to connect and we’ll get you answers.

description: Introducing Project Orca, a remarkable 58-meter superyacht created through a collaboration between RMK the esteemed RMK Yachts Shipyard and the innovative design studio Lagaria. This partnership combines RMK's decades of craftsmanship and technical expertise with Lagaria's fresh perspective and refined aesthetic, resulting in a bold and contemporary vision of the modern superyacht experience. Once under contract, Project Orca can be delivered within 24 months and built to commercial class. There is still time for the owner to select their interior design. The RMK Orca 58M is sophisticated in both design and functionality, featuring advanced solutions wrapped in a sleek, minimalistic profile that reflects a commitment to innovation while honoring timeless style. From the very first glance, Project Orca demands attention with its clean angular lines and contemporary silhouette. The yacht's sculpted profile strikes a perfect balance between strength and elegance, presenting a bold presence that confidently asserts itself without being overly ostentatious. The crisp horizontal lines running bow to stern give the yacht a sleep, elongated feel, emphasizing her 190-foot length. Her expansive glazing offers not just panoramic views, but also floods the interior with natural light, creating a seamless connection between inside and out. The aft cascading terraces are visually striking and unique - they extend the profile into the sea, making the yacht appear like it's flowing into the water itself. The use of contrasting superstructure colors adds a layer of modern sophistication without disrupting the overall harmony of the design. Project Orca feels just as at home in St. Tropez as it would anchored-off of a remote island in the Maldives - contemporary, timeless, and versatile. What makes Project Ocra especially compelling is that it's not just about looks - this yacht is designed for real, elevated living at sea. The main deck aft features fold-down bulwarks and a flush 20'x 10' pool, transforming into a vast, seal-level lounge. It creates a beach club-like atmosphere without sacrificing deck space. Generous deck overhangs and shaded areas ensure usability across all climates. Whether sun-drenched or rain-swept, every deck is a usable, protected environment. The step-down aft platforms offer not only direct water access but also an amphitheater-like layout - perfect for entertaining and relaxing. Multiple outdoor lounging and dining zones across all levels provide privacy and unmatched flexibility for both guest experience and crew service. The wide beam and high-volume design (approximately 1,000GT) promise substantial interior space, allowing for customizable layouts, generous cabins, a gym, skylounge, or whatever the owner desires.

description:
The 2011 Sunseeker 112 yacht
Precioso
features a striking dark blue hull complemented by crisp white topsides and deck, built to RINA C classification with hull MACH Y certification and unrestricted navigation capabilities. Her design emphasizes open main deck spaces with walk-around teak-laid side decks that step up toward the foredeck, while the transom stern structure incorporates a watertight garage door. The main salon flows seamlessly into the aft deck through sliding doors, creating a connected indoor-outdoor living space. Forward on the port side, the galley is efficiently positioned with a crew mess just ahead. Accommodations include a luxurious full-beam master suite with a marble-floored head and hot tub, along with a four-cabin layout featuring port and starboard VIP guest cabins aft, and forward guest cabins on both sides with twin berths plus Pullman options. The raised helm station is located forward at the center of the bridge deck, complemented by a secondary fully equipped helm. Outdoor living is enhanced by an upper aft deck sunpad, with a shaded sitting and dining area forward under a hardtop, as well as a wet bar and an additional helm station on the starboard side. Crew quarters are positioned forward in the bow, offering two bunk-style berths, a captain’s cabin with a double berth, and three heads in total. The yacht accommodates up to 10 passengers and 5 crew, making Precioso a well-balanced combination of performance, comfort, and elegant design.

description: The Fairline Phantom 43 Sunshine offers an enormous amount of space and comfort despite its modest exterior size of just under 14 meters, making it the ideal family yacht for our inland waters in the Benelux. The swimming platform can be used as storage for a tender thanks to the heavy Opacmare hydraulic gangway and is equipped with a beautiful and maintenance-free Permateek deck in the spring of 2025. In the cockpit, which has enough space for two loose chairs and a table, we find the fixed stairs to the flybridge. There is also a very spacious storage area under the floor, ideal for folding bikes or other items. The flybridge is equipped with a bar unit with storage space, sink, and extra refrigerator, and a table that can easily be converted into a sunbed. The helm is equipped with Raymarine equipment: an E80 full-color display, radar, autopilot, tridata, and a Shipmate VHF radio. The salon has a comfortable and completely reupholstered sofa and new carpeting. The beautiful high-gloss cherry wood high/low coffee table can be unfolded into a large dining table. The galley is particularly spacious and well-equipped with a refrigerator, a large countertop, and double stainless steel sinks. There is a recently certified gas stove and combination microwave installed, and there is plenty of storage space, including under the stairs, where the washing machine is also located. The 43 is equipped with 2 cabins: the luxurious owner's cabin with en-suite bathroom is located at the front of the yacht, and on the starboard side, we find the guest cabin with its own bathroom and ample storage space. The propulsion comes from two nearly indestructible and very well-maintained Volvo Penta TAMD75P EDC 480hp diesel engines, coupled to maintenance-free stainless steel propeller shafts. Naturally, maneuvering is made easy by a heavy Sidepower bow/stern thruster, with a remote control. This stunning Phantom 43, built in 2002 but model year 2003, recognizable by the stainless steel sliding door, was originally delivered in 2004 in the Netherlands and is in above-average condition. It has always been used in freshwater and is equipped with Volvo TAMD75P's with low hours. Of course, this beautiful Phantom 43 comes with a Dutch VAT statement, CE documentation, and the original manual, and the engines were fully serviced last year, with a fresh layer of antifouling applied at that time. Its current owners are very serious enthusiasts, and that is absolutely evident! This must be one of the most beautiful examples on the market. Sunshine is a very nice sailing Phantom 43 in above-average condition and is now located in our sales harbor in Marina Cape Helius in Hellevoetsluis.

description: Diese Azimut 46 Flybridge von 2000/EW 2007 ist ein Beweis für Azimuts Ruf, stilvolles Design mit praktischen Funktionen zu verbinden. Diese Yacht, eines der beliebtesten Modelle von Azimut, verfügt über futuristische Linien mit ihren elliptischen, elektrisch betriebenen Fenstern und dem zurückgeschwungenen Bogen und hatte bei ihrer Einführung einen bedeutenden Eindruck auf dem europäischen Markt. Die 46 Flybridge bietet einen nahtlosen Fluss vom geräumigen Saloon mit erhöhtem internem Steuerstand über die vollwertige Edelstahl-Schiebetür bis zu einem großen, vollständig überdachten Cockpit-Loungebereich mit eingebauten Sitzen. Eine breite, geformte Treppe führt Sie eine Ebene hinauf zur weitläufigen, offenen Flybridge, die clever für Komfort unterwegs und für maximalen sozialen Spaß in Ruhe gestaltet ist! Gebogene Liegeplätze und eine riesige hintere Sonnenunterlage bieten Platz für alle. Eine große Bimini-Abdeckung kann in weniger als wenigen Minuten geöffnet oder verstaut werden, was Sonnenschutz auf der Brücke bietet, während das Cockpit vollständig mit den neuen Abdeckungen verschlossen sein kann. Eine weite, offene und gut ausgestattete Kombüse bietet alle Annehmlichkeiten des Zuhauses und harmoniert mühelos mit dem Salon und dem hinteren Deck. Im weiteren Bereich befindet sich die Mastersuite mit einem großen Doppelbett, einem vollwertigen Ensuite und einem großen Kleiderschrank. Gäste sind vom Luxus nicht ausgeschlossen, da eine große Doppelkabine mit einer Queen-Size-Koje und separatem Zugang zum Gästebad ausgestattet ist. Diese AZ 46 dürfte mit zu den schönsten und best gewarteten Azimut 46 sein, die momentan auf dem Markt sind. Die Mitgliedschaft bei dem ADAC auf dem Wasser: SEA HELP wird mit übernommen. Der derzeitige Besitzer und seine Frau haben Freude daran, in der Adria zu navigieren, und während seiner Zeit hat er das Boot gut gewartet und zahlreiche Upgrades vorgenommen. Die Azimut 46 ist die perfekte Mischung aus italienischer Eleganz und Leistung auf dem Wasser. Mit seinen schlanken, modernen Linien und dem geräumigen Deck strahlt es Luxus aus, ohne überwältigend zu wirken. Im Inneren bietet die Yacht einen gut durchdachten Grundriss mit komfortablen Sitzgelegenheiten, einer voll ausgestatteten Kombüse und Kabinen, die einen gemütlichen Rückzugsort für Übernachtungsfahrten bieten. Die Flybridge bietet einen Panoramablick und einen geselligen Raum, der ideal ist, um Gäste zu unterhalten, während die leistungsstarken Motoren ein sanftes Cruisen und Vertrauen auf See gewährleisten. Ob vor Anker in einer ruhigen Bucht oder beim Erkunden der offenen Gewässer, die Azimut 46 bietet ein raffiniertes Erlebnis, das Stil, Komfort und Zuverlässigkeit vereint - und jede Reise unvergesslich macht.

description:
ARGONAUTS – 102 ft Baia One Hundred | 2011
The 102 ft
ARGONAUTS
is the ultimate yacht for those who demand both elegance and exhilarating performance. Built by Baia as part of the acclaimed One Hundred series, she combines sleek Italian styling with cutting-edge engineering.
Her distinctive purple hull and streamlined profile make a striking first impression, while her contemporary interior, finished in a sophisticated neutral palette, sets the tone for relaxed yet refined living.
But it is her speed and handling that set
ARGONAUTS
apart. A fast-planing motor yacht, she cruises comfortably at 25 knots and reaches an impressive top speed of 40  knots, delivering a thrilling ride without compromising on luxury.
Equipped with a modern Seakeeper stabilizer, tender garage with a 2018 4 Meter  Williams jet tender, state-of-the-art entertainment, and a wide-open flybridge concept, with a walk-through dining area to the Bow Area. The Baia One Hundred is a must-see. Expansive lounging and entertainment areas make her ideal for hosting guests in style.
Argonauts interior exemplifies Italian design at its most spectacular combining comfort and luxury throughout with multiple entertaining areas. private sport bridge, bow with sunshade and lounging sun pads. Private bow dining and walk-through.
Exterior Living
Foredeck:
Large U-shaped seating with Bimini shade, perfect for cocktails at anchor.
Sundeck Overhang:
Expansive sunpads designed for all-day lounging while shading the main deck aft.
Aft Deck:
Stylish al fresco dining with wraparound seating.
FWD opening hatch for aseay walk through to bow.
Interior Features
ARGONAUTS
showcases one of the most remarkable indoor-outdoor transitions of any yacht her size. The panoramic main saloon, bridge, and formal dining area feature sliding glass panels that open fully to merge with exterior decks, or close for privacy and climate control. Overhead glass forward fills the space with natural light, creating an airy, sophisticated atmosphere.
Accommodation
10 Guests
in 4 luxurious cabins:
Full-beam Master Suite
VIP Cabin
2 Twin Cabins (each with Pullman berths)
Day Head on main deck
Immaculately maintained since launch,
ARGONAUTS
has had only
one private owner
and has
never been chartered
. She is offered for sale as her owner takes delivery of a new yacht. While she is in excellent condition, her signature purple paint is due for a refresh/repaint — offering a perfect opportunity for customization.

description: The Linssen Grand Sturdy 40.0 AC is a beautifully lined and high-quality built steel motor yacht from the renowned Dutch shipyard Linssen Yachts. This model is known for its excellent handling characteristics, well-thought-out layout, and durable construction, making the vessel particularly suitable for both relaxed cruises and longer voyages on inland and open waters. The hull is built according to the patented HPH® (Hardchine Prestressed Hull) construction method, resulting in a strong, stable, and comfortable displacement hull. Combined with the powerful and reliable Volvo Penta D3-110 diesel engine and hydraulic steering, this yacht offers optimal control and a smooth, steady course. On deck, the ship features a well-maintained aft deck with comfortable seating and a complete convertible canopy (Sunbrella Dune), ensuring that spending time outdoors is pleasant in various weather conditions. The integrated swimming platform with solid teak and stainless steel swimming ladder completes the ensemble. Inside, you will find a warm and classically finished interior in cherry wood, with a spacious saloon, a well-equipped galley, and several comfortable cabins. The practical layout with aft cabin, forward cabin, and mid-cabin accommodates multiple guests, while the separate shower and toilet facilities contribute to onboard comfort. The yacht is further equipped with, among other things, a bow and stern thruster, an extensive heating system, hot water supply, and full tank capacities, making extended stays on board effortless. In short, the Linssen Grand Sturdy 40.0 AC combines craftsmanship, comfort, and reliability in a timeless design, and is an excellent choice for the discerning water sports enthusiast.

description:
Riva Super Florida – Baunummer 943 – Baujahr 1965

Zum Verkauf steht eine Riva Super Florida, Baunummer 943, aus dem Baujahr 1965 – ein eleganter und seltener Klassiker aus dem Hause Riva mit zeitloser Linienführung und unverwechselbarem Charme.

Das Boot verfügt über eine Länge von 6,10 m und eine Breite von 2,16 m. Angetrieben wird es von einem originalen Chris Craft 283 H V8-Motor, ebenfalls Baujahr 1965, mit 185 kW, ca 1600 Betriebsstunden. Verbaut ist zudem ein 140-Liter-Edelstahltank.

Das Boot eignet sich daher ideal für Kenner, Liebhaber und Sammler klassischer Holzboote, die den technischen Feinschliff selbst übernehmen oder fachgerecht ausführen lassen möchten.

Die Riva Super Florida zählt zu den besonders begehrten offenen Runabouts der Marke und ist heute ein selten gewordenes Sammlerstück mit viel Potenzial. Dieses Boot bietet eine sehr gute Basis für einen stilvollen Klassiker mit Wertbeständigkeit und besonderer Ausstrahlung auf jedem See.

Because this boat isn’t built for one type of owner—it’s built for all your different sides. The adventurer. The host. The explorer. The dreamer.
